name: Chill Medicated | 600mg Syrup | Zero Sugar Dreamberry 2:2:2 THC:CBD:CBN
description:
Dosage: 200mg THC : 200mg CBD : 200mg CBN

Activation Time: 5 Minutes - 15 Minutes

120ML | 4 FL OZ

A lush fusion of ripe blueberries and wild blackberries with a subtle, calming sweetness.

Drift off, don't knock out.

Dreamberry Snooze Syrup is a delicious nighttime formula that carefully blends THC, CBN, and CBD in a calming ratio designed for deep, consistent sleep. A juicy blend of blueberries, blackberries, and raspberries that's sweet, a little tart, and easy to sip. Like your favorite late-night snack, just more chill.

The Sleep Stack-

200mg THC + 200mg CBN + 200mg CBD—balanced for a gradual wind-down and a peaceful night, helping you stay asleep and wake up more rested without any drowsiness. THC and CBN work together to interact with your body's endocannabinoid system to help your body and mind relax, while CBD adds support.

Support Restful Sleep-

Perfect for nighttime routines—many users report an easier time falling and staying asleep with more consistent rest.
